#!/usr/bin/env bash
2: # Run from a trusted Cargo workspace. Additional arguments are Cargo feature flags.
3: # Example: gates.sh --no-default-features --features 'server,tls'
4: # No arguments: --all-features. RUST_GATE_FEATURES= disables that default.
5: set -uo pipefail
6: export CARGO_TERM_COLOR=never
7: [[ -f Cargo.toml ]] || { echo 'Run gates.sh from the Cargo workspace root.' >&2; exit 2; }
8: features=(--all-features)
9: if [[ ${RUST_GATE_FEATURES+x} ]]; then
10:   read -r -a features <<< "$RUST_GATE_FEATURES"
11: fi
12: if (( $# )); then features=("$@"); fi
13: for arg in "${features[@]}"; do
14:   case "$arg" in --manifest-path*|--target-dir*|--config*|--help|--version) echo "Unsupported feature argument: $arg" >&2; exit 2;; esac
15: done
16: locked=()
17: [[ ! -f Cargo.lock ]] || locked=(--locked)
18: failed=0
19: run_gate() {
20:   local name=$1; shift
21:   printf '\n$' >&2; printf ' %q' "$@" >&2; printf '\n' >&2
22:   if "$@" >&2; then printf -- '- %s: PASS\n' "$name"
23:   else printf -- '- %s: FAIL\n' "$name"; failed=1; fi
24: }
25: run_gate fmt cargo fmt --all -- --check
26: run_gate clippy bash "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/clippy.sh" --workspace --all-targets "${features[@]}" "${locked[@]}" -- -D warnings
27: if cargo nextest --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
28:   run_gate tests cargo nextest run --workspace "${features[@]}" "${locked[@]}" --no-fail-fast --no-tests=pass
29:   run_gate doctests cargo test --workspace --doc "${features[@]}" "${locked[@]}"
30: else
31:   # cargo test includes doctests by default; no --all-targets here.
32:   run_gate tests cargo test --workspace "${features[@]}" "${locked[@]}" --no-fail-fast
33:   echo '- doctests: N/A (included in cargo test)'
34: fi
35: if [[ ! -f deny.toml ]]; then
36:   echo '- deny: NOT RUN (deny.toml missing)'; failed=1
37: elif ! cargo deny --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
38:   echo '- deny: NOT RUN (cargo-deny missing)'; failed=1
39: else
40:   run_gate deny cargo deny "${locked[@]}" check
41: fi
42: exit "$failed"","src/lib.rs":"1: #[cfg(feature = "model")]

2: # Preserve Clippy's exit status independently of optional diagnostic presentation.
3: set -uo pipefail
4: export CARGO_TERM_COLOR=never
5: if [[ ${RUST_REVIEWDOG:-0} != 1 ]]; then
6:   exec cargo clippy "$@"
7: fi
8: logs=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rust-review-clippy.XXXXXXXX") || exit 2
9: printf 'Clippy/reviewdog evidence: %s\n' "$logs" >&2
10: # Capture raw output without a pipeline; retain unfiltered compiler errors.
11: cargo clippy --message-format=short --color=never "$@" > "$logs/clippy.log" 2>&1
12: clippy_status=$?
13: printf '%s\n' "$clippy_status" > "$logs/clippy.exit"
14: cat "$logs/clippy.log" >&2
15: reviewdog_bin=${RUST_REVIEWDOG_BIN:-reviewdog}
16: if ! command -v "$reviewdog_bin" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
17:   echo 'reviewdog: NOT RUN (optional tool missing; Clippy result retained)' >&2
18:   exit "$clippy_status"
19: fi
20: args=(-f=clippy -reporter=local -filter-mode=nofilter -fail-level=warning)
21: if [[ -n ${RUST_REVIEWDOG_BASE:-} ]]; then
22:   # Only a resolved commit hash enters reviewdog's shell diff command.
23:   if base=$(git rev-parse --verify --end-of-options "${RUST_REVIEWDOG_BASE}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null); then
24:     args=(-f=clippy -reporter=local -filter-mode=added -fail-level=warning
25:       "-diff=git diff --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --no-color $base --")
26:   else
27:     echo 'reviewdog: invalid base; displaying unfiltered diagnostics' >&2
28:   fi
29: fi
30: "$reviewdog_bin" "${args[@]}" < "$logs/clippy.log" > "$logs/reviewdog.log" 2> "$logs/reviewdog.stderr"
31: reviewdog_status=$?
32: printf '%s\n' "$reviewdog_status" > "$logs/reviewdog.exit"
33: cat "$logs/reviewdog.log" "$logs/reviewdog.stderr" >&2
34: printf 'reviewdog: exit=%s (presentation only; Clippy exit=%s)\n' "$reviewdog_status" "$clippy_status" >&2
35: if [[ ! -s "$logs/reviewdog.log" ]]; then
36:   echo 'Empty reviewdog report is not evidence of Clippy PASS; inspect clippy.log.' >&2
37: fi

2: 
3: Read by the Codex `rust-pr-review` skill. Adapt the project policy below before
4: using this template as a merge gate. Existing repository contracts take precedence.
5: 
6: ## Severity
7: 
8: | Level | Meaning |
9: |---|---|
10: | P0 | Proven critical defect with broad impact: memory unsoundness, data destruction or secret disclosure |
11: | P1 | Reachable regression, broken contract, deadlock or other defect that must be fixed before merge |
12: | P2 | Concrete non-blocking correctness, maintainability or measured performance issue |
13: | P3 | Optional actionable improvement; omit taste-only comments |
14: 
15: Determine priority from reachability, impact and preconditions. A panic, unsafe block,
16: clone, lint violation or failing command does not automatically establish P0/P1.
17: Distinguish environment failures and pre-existing failures from defects in the diff.
18: Each finding needs an exact location, trigger, impact and practical fix. For a deletion,
19: identify its base-side location explicitly; never invent a current line for missing code.
20: 
21: ## Project policy (configure)
22: 
23: - Use the actual edition, MSRV, toolchain, lint levels and error conventions in this repo.
24: - Review public API compatibility against the project's supported release baseline.
25: - Check unsafe invariants, aliasing/lifetimes, ownership across FFI and Send/Sync claims.
26: - Check async blocking, lock order, cancellation, bounded resource use and error paths.
27: - Require tests for meaningful behavior changes where they protect against regressions.
28: - Default checks: fmt, clippy, tests (including doctests), cargo-deny with deny.toml.
29: - Default feature configuration: --all-features. Replace with the supported feature
30:   matrix for mutually exclusive features; align local checks and CI.
31: - Configure deny.toml using the project's license, advisory and source policy.
32: - Only mark deny N/A if project policy explicitly makes it inapplicable; missing
33:   cargo-deny or deny.toml means NOT RUN. If required evidence is absent, INCOMPLETE.
34: - Spec PASS requires user requirements or PR acceptance criteria; commit claims alone
35:   yield PARTIAL. No findings does not mean all requirements were verified.
36: - For affected unsafe/FFI boundaries, targeted Miri tests and a separate aliasing/
37:   provenance argument are required before approval. Use isolated exact-source probes
38:   when existing tests do not cover the path and execution is authorized. Unknown FFI

1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
2: # Run from a trusted Cargo workspace. Additional arguments are Cargo feature flags.
3: # Example: gates.sh --no-default-features --features 'server,tls'
4: # No arguments: --all-features. RUST_GATE_FEATURES= disables that default.
5: set -uo pipefail
6: export CARGO_TERM_COLOR=never
7: [[ -f Cargo.toml ]] || { echo 'Run gates.sh from the Cargo workspace root.' >&2; exit 2; }
8: features=(--all-features)
9: if [[ ${RUST_GATE_FEATURES+x} ]]; then
10:   read -r -a features <<< "$RUST_GATE_FEATURES"
11: fi
12: if (( $# )); then features=("$@"); fi
13: for arg in "${features[@]}"; do
14:   case "$arg" in --manifest-path*|--target-dir*|--config*|--help|--version) echo "Unsupported feature argument: $arg" >&2; exit 2;; esac
15: done
16: locked=()
17: [[ ! -f Cargo.lock ]] || locked=(--locked)
18: failed=0
19: run_gate() {
20:   local name=$1; shift
21:   printf '\n$' >&2; printf ' %q' "$@" >&2; printf '\n' >&2
22:   if "$@" >&2; then printf -- '- %s: PASS\n' "$name"
23:   else printf -- '- %s: FAIL\n' "$name"; failed=1; fi
24: }
25: run_gate fmt cargo fmt --all -- --check
26: run_gate clippy bash "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/clippy.sh" --workspace --all-targets "${features[@]}" "${locked[@]}" -- -D warnings
27: if cargo nextest --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
28:   run_gate tests cargo nextest run --workspace "${features[@]}" "${locked[@]}" --no-fail-fast --no-tests=pass
29:   run_gate doctests cargo test --workspace --doc "${features[@]}" "${locked[@]}"
30: else
31:   # cargo test includes doctests by default; no --all-targets here.
32:   run_gate tests cargo test --workspace "${features[@]}" "${locked[@]}" --no-fail-fast
33:   echo '- doctests: N/A (included in cargo test)'
34: fi
35: if [[ ! -f deny.toml ]]; then
36:   echo '- deny: NOT RUN (deny.toml missing)'; failed=1
37: elif ! cargo deny --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
38:   echo '- deny: NOT RUN (cargo-deny missing)'; failed=1
39: else
40:   run_gate deny cargo deny "${locked[@]}" check
41: fi
42: exit "$failed"

1: # Optional local reviewdog
2: 
3: Run from the reviewed Cargo workspace:
4: 
5: ```bash
6: RUST_REVIEWDOG=1 bash .agents/skills/rust-pr-review/scripts/gates.sh
7: ```
8: 
9: The helper runs Clippy once, preserves raw uncolored short diagnostics and its exit
10: code in a printed temporary evidence directory, then feeds that file to reviewdog.
11: It uses the local reporter only and installs nothing. Missing reviewdog falls back
12: to the raw diagnostics. Its errors/status are separate from the Clippy gate.
13: `RUST_REVIEWDOG_BIN` can select an existing executable by name or absolute path.
14: Retain the evidence files until the review is complete.
15: 
16: Default filtering is `nofilter`. For tracked branch plus working-tree changes, set
17: `RUST_REVIEWDOG_BASE` to the already resolved review base SHA. For working-tree-only
18: review, use HEAD. For a committed-only scope, use matching checkout/CI evidence;
19: this helper's diff includes local edits. Invalid bases fall back to unfiltered output.
20: Git diff excludes untracked files: omit the base when they are in scope.
21: 
22: Always derive the `clippy` gate from Clippy's exit status, not reviewdog's report or
23: exit status. Inspect raw output on compilation failure, parser failure or an empty
24: report. A successful reviewdog process with zero displayed diagnostics is not a
25: passing lint check. Record presentation failures/omissions separately in the report;
26: reviewdog does not replace Miri, Loom, tests or semantic review.
27: 
28: If the project already has `.reviewdog.yml` or `.reviewdog.yaml`, prefer its relevant
29: lint runners with `-reporter=local -filter-mode=nofilter -fail-level=warning` for
30: project presentation. Still run the Clippy gate independently: config runners may
31: filter, mask failures or use different flags. Do not automatically execute every
32: runner. Do not feed RTK-condensed output to a parser; use `rtk bypass` for a producer
33: if it is intercepted. The helper calls Cargo directly without a condensing wrapper.
34: Remote reporters require an explicit request to publish results.

1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
2: # Preserve Clippy's exit status independently of optional diagnostic presentation.
3: set -uo pipefail
4: export CARGO_TERM_COLOR=never
5: if [[ ${RUST_REVIEWDOG:-0} != 1 ]]; then
6:   exec cargo clippy "$@"
7: fi
8: logs=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rust-review-clippy.XXXXXXXX") || exit 2
9: printf 'Clippy/reviewdog evidence: %s\n' "$logs" >&2
10: # Capture raw output without a pipeline; retain unfiltered compiler errors.
11: cargo clippy --message-format=short --color=never "$@" > "$logs/clippy.log" 2>&1
12: clippy_status=$?
13: printf '%s\n' "$clippy_status" > "$logs/clippy.exit"
14: cat "$logs/clippy.log" >&2
15: reviewdog_bin=${RUST_REVIEWDOG_BIN:-reviewdog}
16: if ! command -v "$reviewdog_bin" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
17:   echo 'reviewdog: NOT RUN (optional tool missing; Clippy result retained)' >&2
18:   exit "$clippy_status"
19: fi
20: args=(-f=clippy -reporter=local -filter-mode=nofilter -fail-level=warning)
21: if [[ -n ${RUST_REVIEWDOG_BASE:-} ]]; then
22:   # Only a resolved commit hash enters reviewdog's shell diff command.
23:   if base=$(git rev-parse --verify --end-of-options "${RUST_REVIEWDOG_BASE}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null); then
24:     args=(-f=clippy -reporter=local -filter-mode=added -fail-level=warning
25:       "-diff=git diff --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --no-color $base --")
26:   else
27:     echo 'reviewdog: invalid base; displaying unfiltered diagnostics' >&2
28:   fi
29: fi
30: "$reviewdog_bin" "${args[@]}" < "$logs/clippy.log" > "$logs/reviewdog.log" 2> "$logs/reviewdog.stderr"
31: reviewdog_status=$?
32: printf '%s\n' "$reviewdog_status" > "$logs/reviewdog.exit"
33: cat "$logs/reviewdog.log" "$logs/reviewdog.stderr" >&2
34: printf 'reviewdog: exit=%s (presentation only; Clippy exit=%s)\n' "$reviewdog_status" "$clippy_status" >&2
35: if [[ ! -s "$logs/reviewdog.log" ]]; then
36:   echo 'Empty reviewdog report is not evidence of Clippy PASS; inspect clippy.log.' >&2
37: fi
38: exit "$clippy_status"

9: |---|---|

12: | P2 | Concrete non-blocking correctness, maintainability or measured performance issue |
13: | P3 | Optional actionable improvement; omit taste-only comments |
